The notorious 'Timekeeper' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching him. As she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel must use her skills to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. With the help of a local detective, Rachel must unravel the Timekeeper's cryptic messages and outsmart his cunning tactics. But as the body count rises, Rachel realizes that the Timekeeper's true intentions are far more sinister than she ever imagined.
